title: MUFG aims to become AI-native with OpenAI
summary: MUFG uses ChatGPT Enterprise to build an AI-native organization, improve workflows, and deliver new AI-powered financial services at scale.
body: MUFG uses ChatGPT Enterprise to build an AI-native organization, improve workflows, and deliver new AI-powered financial services at scale.
summaryZh: 三菱UFJ银行（MUFG）宣布采用ChatGPT Enterprise，旨在重塑内部工作流程，全面向AI原生组织转型，并在金融服务领域规模化交付AI驱动的新服务。
